For WLY and PSO, specifically verify whether any OPM, courseware, or institutional education-services assets remain material after portfolio changes; external evidence only confirms historical/competitive relevance through a LOPE-related source.

Need market-pricing checks for all names in this chunk: market cap, liquidity, analyst coverage, valuation versus growth, and whether education exposure is large enough to matter at the enterprise level.

summary: This Layer 2B chunk maps public-market relationships for consumer learning, assessment/testing, academic content, professional-learning data, and international tutoring references. The chunk is mostly reference-lane rather than core underfollowed-chokepoint exposure. The strongest Serenity fit inside the chunk is WLY as a potentially underfollowed academic/professional content and legacy OPM/courseware infrastructure candidate, but its current revenue purity and post-portfolio-change education exposure must be verified. PSO is a larger reference benchmark for assessment/content/credentialing. DUOL is a high-attention benchmark for AI-enabled consumer learning and digital assessment economics, not an underfollowed chokepoint. CHGG is a speculative shadow candidate mainly useful as an AI-disruption stress case for direct-to-student learning tools. RELX, EDU, and TAL are retained as references, but their broad business mix or country-specific policy risk weakens direct Serenity priority until segment-level exposure and regulatory boundaries are verified.
